no_adcom_quote.quote: The review did not prompt any questions that would have required input from an Advisory Committee.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for NDA211150 (WAKIX/pitolisant). The medical review states the review did not prompt any questions requiring Advisory Committee input, and the Summary Review's Advisory Committee Meeting section is marked not applicable. Instead of an AdComm, the Division sought external consultation with the EMA via teleconference on March 11, 2019 to discuss safety, efficacy, long-term 40 mg safety, and abuse liability.
